title: quadrature points
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkQuadraturePointsGenerator and vtkQuadraturePointInterpolator by reading a quadratic unstructured grid, generating quadrature scheme dictionaries, interpolating fields, warping, clipping, thresholding, and rendering quadrature points as glyphs alongside the warped surface.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkDataObject](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataObject.html) — provides field association constants for array processing.
- [vtkDataSetSurfaceFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetSurfaceFilter.html) — data set surface filter.
- [vtkDoubleArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDoubleArray.html) — double array.
- [vtkExtractGeometry](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkExtractGeometry.html) — extracts cells that lie inside an implicit function.
- [vtkGlyph3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGlyph3D.html) — places oriented, scaled glyphs at each point.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkQuadraturePointInterpolator](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkQuadraturePointInterpolator.html) — quadrature point interpolator.
- [vtkQuadraturePointsGenerator](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkQuadraturePointsGenerator.html) — quadrature points generator.
- [vtkQuadratureSchemeDictionaryGenerator](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkQuadratureSchemeDictionaryGenerator.html) — quadrature scheme dictionary generator.
- [vtkSphereSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSphereSource.html) — generates a tessellated sphere.
- [vtkUnstructuredGridReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkUnstructuredGridReader.html) — unstructured grid reader.
- [vtkWarpVector](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkWarpVector.html) — warp vector.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
